description: Fork of exp662. Split joint qkv_lut into SEPARATE qk_lut + v_lut, each using the same S=4 sparsify (n_heads=H*S=24). qk_lut: NAP=4 (K=16), tph=64, n_out=2*d_qk/S=32 -> per layer 24*64*16*32 = 786,432 = 4.72M total. v_lut: NAP=6 (K=64), tph=64, n_out=d_v/S=16 -> per layer 24*64*64*16 = 1,572,864 = 9.44M total. qk+v combined: 14.16M (vs exp662 joint qkv = 28.31M, vs exp659 sep qk+v = 23.59M). Expected total params ~77M. Tests whether splitting the joint qkv into specialized qk (light, NAP=4 K=16) + v (denser NAP=6 K=64) wins over either joint qkv or original separate qk+v. Reference: exp662 joint qkv = (in progress), exp659 sep qk+v = 1.4820 (86.5M), exp660 = 1.4745 (qk_tph=64 only, 100M), vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
